title: Explaining selective light-driven N-alkylation
difficulty_reasons: The open selectivity question requires independently chosen explanations and discriminating, actually executed investigations.
Reliable inference must separate an observed product preference from conclusions conditional on a chemical or kinetic model.
Model adequacy, comparison conventions and uncertainty must be defended without a hidden author workflow or numerical answer target.

paper.title: Visible-Light-Driven N-Alkylation of Quinoxalin-2(1H)-ones With Aryl Diazo Esters

data.description: Neutral reactant identities, reaction conditions, observed product identity and isolated yield, and the scientific question.
